verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a documented liability model (marketplace's liable balance account, three chargeback-handling options, ability to accept liability or request defense documents) but do not explicitly describe automatic debiting against a seller's future earnings or their bank account when a chargeback exceeds balance. missing for 10: explicit negative-balance/future-earnings debit mechanism, explicit bank-account debit/recovery process, and independent confirmation of these recovery flows.
